exit(1) 						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						   exit(1)

NAME
       exit command - Exits a tmsh module or component.

MODULE
       All tmsh modules.

SYNTAX
       Use the command exit within a tmsh module or component to leave that module or component and return to the higher level of
       the shell structure.

	exit

       Note that to exit tmsh and return to the BIG-IP(r) system prompt, use the command quit.

DESCRIPTION
       For more information about the structure of tmsh, see the Traffic Management Shell (tmsh) Reference Guide.

SEE ALSO
       tmsh
